lane_note: Lane 0 only (gate-first spec §3). G1–G4 are gate tasks whose amendment.md the owner must review before M1–M6 are decomposed; M0 is the independent recording repair. M1–M6 tasks are added by a later /sdd-task run after the gate amendments land.

tasks.title: G1/S1 gate — FSRS-6 reference parity and 30-day calibration report
tasks.parallelism_notes: graph root (gate G1): writes only tests/memory/dynamics/spikes/s1_fsrs/* and sdd/state/FEAT-571/spikes/s1-fsrs-parity/*; imports nothing from sibling tasks; proposes amendment.md instead of editing the spec, so no file overlap with S2–S4; vendored reference is task-local

tasks.title: G2/S2 gate — concurrent local episodic backend and durable review application
tasks.parallelism_notes: graph root (gate G2): writes only tests/memory/dynamics/spikes/s2_storage/* and sdd/state/FEAT-571/spikes/s2-concurrent-storage/*; the 8-process load runs against tmp_path SQLite/FAISS files only (no shared .parrot/ state, no DDL on a shared DB), so it is not exclusive; documents PG/Redis non-atomicity from source without live runs

tasks.title: G3/S3 gate — attribution precision and verified-outcome evidence schema
tasks.parallelism_notes: graph root (gate G3): writes only tests/memory/dynamics/spikes/s3_attribution/* and sdd/state/FEAT-571/spikes/s3-attribution/* (judgments.jsonl is task-local, hash-only); reads mixin/tools/engine/ledger source read-only; U1/U3 are owner acceptance decisions, not depends_on edges

tasks.title: G4/S4 gate — brain page state storage, version identity and lineage
tasks.parallelism_notes: graph root (gate G4): writes only tests/memory/dynamics/spikes/s4_brain_state/* and sdd/state/FEAT-571/spikes/s4-brain-state/*; uses a tmp_path SQLite wiki store, never .parrot/; the 'coordinate with G2 before passing' rule (spec §3) is an amendment cross-reference at review time, not a start dependency

tasks.title: M0 — repair UnifiedMemoryManager episodic recording with a real-store regression test
tasks.parallelism_notes: graph root (M0, spec §3 'no dynamics dependency'): sole writer of memory/unified/manager.py, tests/memory/unified/test_manager.py and the new test_manager_real_store.py within this feature; imports only existing episodic models/store/FAISS backend; delegation-eligible (Delegation Contract present)
